# Obtaining the Fermat source

Kira and Fermatica can call Fermat as a standalone program. CANON includes the
Wolfram interface in the [Fermatica source directory](../Fermatica/README.md).

The author lists the sources for Fermat 6.21 and 6.37 under the GNU GPL and asks
users to request them by email. CANON did not obtain the source or identify an
upstream Git repository for those releases, so this distribution contains neither
the source nor an executable. [Fermat author's site](https://home.bway.net/lewis/)

After obtaining the source, you can place it in this directory and follow the
author's build and installation instructions. Set `FERMATPATH` to the full path to
the installed Fermat executable, or set ``Fermatica`$FermatCMD`` in a Wolfram
session.
